title: Notifications
subtitle: Things waiting for you: approvals you can decide, content to review, comments to moderate and failed operations.
empty_help: New approvals, review requests, comments and failures appear here and on the bell in the top bar.
scope: Items come from the last 7 days and follow your permissions. Each item opens the page where you can act.
gone: That item no longer needs attention.
approval: Agent action waiting for your approval
handoff: An agent handed a task to you
backup_retention_failed: Old backups could not be removed
